Numeric publication admission is independently captured in batch or isolated Publish results. Runtime conclusions require receipts, not successful Publish alone.

Five-place policy operands 1.23456 and 1.23457 were used, but rejection of greater-precision policy operands was not separately retested here. Six- and seven-place published Numbers were admitted and delivered through strict interior numeric comparisons without matching either endpoint.

The initial fresh subscription attempt exceeded SNS's five-key filter-policy limit and created no subscription. Its full native rejection and verified cleanup are retained under previous_attempts; the successful attempt used a five-key conjunctive policy with control alternatives.
